youtube.title: Which animal makes the longest migration on Earth? Most people guess wrong 🧭
youtube.description:
The ocean giant, the famous butterfly, or the third one? The record holder weighs about as much as a bar of soap, sees two summers every year, and over its lifetime travels further than a trip to the Moon and back — three times.
Which did you pick?
